newsitem.title: CAYMAN ISLANDS: SOCCER-KIDD HELPING CAYMAN ISLANDS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KIDD HELPING CAYMAN ISLANDS.

text.p: Brian Kidd, assistant manager of English premier league champions Manchester United, is spending three weeks in the Cayman Islands helping their soccer programme, CANA news agency said.
Kidd said he would help develop the national youth programme and assist the coaching the various national teams.
CANA quoted Kidd as saying he hoped coaches from the Cayman Islands would go to England to observe the Manchester United coaching system and learn their techniques.
